defs.d: A room, often in a school, where classes take place
The first meal of the day, usually eaten in the morning.
defs.ex: You should put more protein in her breakfast so she will grow.

defs.d: (by extension) A meal consisting of food normally eaten in the morning, which may typically include eggs, sausages, toast, bacon, etc.
defs.ex: We serve breakfast all day.

defs.d: To eat the morning meal.
To serve breakfast to.
An abstract archetype of a given thing, compared to which real-life examples are seen as imperfect approximations; pure essence, as opposed to actual examples.
The conception of someone or something as representing a perfect example; an ideal.
(general) A sport played on foot in which teams attempt to get a ball into a goal or zone defended by the other team.
defs.ex: Roman and medieval football matches were more violent than any modern type of football.

defs.d: Association football: a game in which two teams each contend to get a round ball into the other team's goal primarily by kicking the ball. Known as soccer in Canada, the United States, Australia, and New Zealand.
defs.ex: Each team scored three goals when they played football.

defs.d: To play football.
A large self-service store that sells groceries and, usually, medications, household goods and/or clothing.
defs.ex: I went to the supermarket to buy some food.

defs.d: A chain of such stores.
Something opposite or contrary to something else.
An opponent.
Located directly across from something else, or from each other.
defs.ex: She saw him walking on the opposite side of the road.

defs.d: Of leaves and flowers, positioned directly across from each other on a stem.
In an opposite position.
defs.ex: I was on my seat and she stood opposite.

defs.d: To try not to meet or communicate with (a person); to shun
To keep away from; to keep clear of; to stay away from
defs.ex: I try to avoid the company of gamblers.

defs.d: Something that is produced, consumed, used, or done every day.
To drive an automobile frequently, on a daily basis, for regular and mundane tasks.
That occurs every day, or at least every working day
Diurnal, by daylight, as opposed to nightly
A substance able to mix with both oil and water, used for cleaning, often in the form of a solid bar or in liquid form, derived from fats or made synthetically.
defs.ex: I tried washing my hands with soap, but the stain wouldn't go away.

defs.d: A metallic salt derived from a fatty acid
To apply soap to in washing.
defs.ex: Be sure to soap yourself well before rinsing.

defs.d: To cover, lather or in any other form treat with soap, often as a prank.
defs.ex: Those kids soaped my windows!

defs.d: In or to the front; in advance; onward.
In the direction one is facing or moving.
defs.ex: Just ahead you can see the cliffs.

defs.d: The science and art of military command as applied to the overall planning and conduct of warfare.
A plan of action intended to accomplish a specific goal.
An instance of exhibiting, or something exhibited.
A large-scale public showing of objects or products.
defs.ex: There was an art exhibition on in the town hall.

defs.d: A person who, or thing that, protects or watches over something.
defs.ex: The prison guard unlocked the door of the cell.   After completing the repairs, he replaced the sump guard.

defs.d: A garda; a police officer.
To protect from danger; to secure against surprise, attack, or injury; to keep in safety; to defend.
To keep watch over, in order to prevent escape or restrain from acts of violence, or the like.
defs.ex: Guard the prisoner.

defs.d: To make ready for a specific future purpose; to set up; to assemble or equip.
defs.ex: We prepared the spacecraft for takeoff.

defs.d: To make ready for eating or drinking; to cook.
defs.ex: We prepared a fish for dinner.

defs.d: (followed by the preposition to) Disposed, willing, ready (to do something).
defs.ex: The journalist interviewed an eye-witness who was not prepared to disclose his identity.

defs.d: The portion of the upper human appendage, from the shoulder to the wrist and sometimes including the hand.
defs.ex: She stood with her right arm extended and her palm forward to indicate “Stop!”

defs.d: The extended portion of the upper limb, from the shoulder to the elbow.
defs.ex: The arm and forearm are parts of the upper limb in the human body.

defs.d: (usually used in the plural) A weapon.
(in the plural) Heraldic bearings or insignia.
defs.ex: The Duke's arms were a sable gryphon rampant on an argent field.

defs.d: To feel shame; to be ashamed.
To make ashamed; to shame.
Feeling shame or guilt.
A smaller, self-contained part of a larger entity. Often refers to a manufactured object that is part of a larger device.
defs.ex: A CPU is a component of a computer.

defs.d: Making up a larger whole; as a component word.
Made up of smaller complete units in combination; as a component stereo.
In the context of which the present document or ruling is made.
defs.ex: the within appeal

defs.d: In or into the interior; inside.
In the inner part, spatially; physically inside.
defs.ex: within her studio

defs.d: In the scope or range of.
defs.ex: within his hearing;  her  within five seconds of breaking the record;  within an inch of falling overboard

defs.d: A transmission of a radio or television programme intended to be received by anyone with a receiver.
A programme (bulletin, documentary, show, etc.) so transmitted.
defs.ex: The DJ was feeling nervous before his first national broadcast.

defs.d: To transmit a message or signal through radio waves or electronic means.
To transmit a message over a wide area; specifically, to send an email in a single transmission to a (typically large) number of people.
Cast or scattered widely in all directions; cast abroad.
Communicated, signalled, or transmitted through radio waves or electronic means.
(temporal location) At a later or succeeding time.
A group or association of cooperating members.
defs.ex: the League of Nations

defs.d: An organization of sports teams which play against one another for a championship.
defs.ex: My favorite sports organizations are the National Football League and the American League in baseball.

defs.d: To form an association; to unite in a league or confederacy; to combine for mutual support.
A version of rugby football, played between two teams of thirteen.
One who opposes another; one who works or takes a position against someone or something; one who attempts to stop the progress of someone or something.
defs.ex: During the crackdown, many opponents of the regime were arrested.

defs.d: Opposing; adverse; antagonistic.
Situated in front; opposite.
